name: Drinking Wine Alcohol
overview: Scripture warns that wine and strong drink can deceive and lead to unwise behavior, as Proverbs 20:1 highlights their potential to mock and rage. Believers are encouraged to avoid anything, including wine, that might cause a fellow Christian to stumble or be weakened, emphasizing the importance of love and consideration in Romans 14:21. Furthermore, Ephesians 5:18 instructs Christians not to become drunk with wine, which leads to excess, but rather to be filled with the Spirit, underscoring the call to live under the guidance of the Holy Spirit instead of indulgence.
